manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Shows a tossed ball and a dropped ball at the top, comparing velocity and acceleration.
manifest.description: Two side‑by‑side lanes display a tossed ball and a ball held by a gate at the apex. Velocity and acceleration arrows update as time runs, and readouts report their values.
assumptions: No air resistance, same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
